paragraphs: Hyman reports him in the Salonika printing at Eruvin 8a; the text Hyman uses reads bar Malkiyu.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Eruvin 8b has a chain naming Rav Kahana bar Malkiyu. Hyman cites 8a and reports the Tuvia form from the Salonika printing; that printing has not been inspected here.

The actual William Davidson Eruvin 8b paragraph names Rav Kahana bar Malkiyu in a chain. Hyman’s 8a locator and Salonika bar Tuvia report remain attributed to him. The Salonika printing has not been freshly inspected; the two patronymics are not harmonized and the longer chain supplies no new identity binding.
